figurative_meaning_en: To beat someone so severely that their bones are crushed
similar_in_english: Beat the living daylights out of someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীকে আস্ত না রেখেছে, পুরোপুরি মেরে ফেলেছে।
যদি তুমি এভাবে চালিয়ে যাও, তোমাকে আস্ত না রাখব।
example_sentences_in_english: He didn't leave his rival in one piece; he beat him badly.
If you continue like this, I won't leave you unharmed.
note: This idiom vividly expresses intense physical retaliation, common in Bengali folk expressions.
